baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ أَرُونِيَ الَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُم بِهِ شُرَكَاءَ
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered command requires the addressees to convert an asserted association into an inspectable referent and an intelligible joining relation. The causative attachment makes them authors of the relation, while partnership specifies the shared stake they must exhibit.

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance makes the challenge a public command rather than an inward supposition.
Causative showing supplies the demanded move from assertion to presented evidence.
Making one thing reach and join another locates the disputed linkage in the addressees' act.
A shared stake defines what the alleged attached parties would have to possess.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply denies that other gods exist.
changed_reading.after: The ayah places a burden of production on the claimants: present the alleged co-participants and the relation by which they acquired a share.

baseline_models.mechanism: The affiliation branch of attachment and the affinal branch of partnership activate a juridical or genealogical graft. The partners are not discovered as inherently related to God; they are assigned a status by the addressees, and the corrective كَلَّا بَلْ annuls that assignment.

activation_trace.role: Attaching an affiliate to a group or false lineage supplies the image of an attributed status without native belonging.
Affinal and neighboring partnership sharpens the disputed relation as a manufactured kin-like association.
Judgment supplies the authority that rejects the unauthorized affiliation.

changed_reading.before: The error is only numerical, adding more deities.
changed_reading.after: The error is also relational forgery: the claimants confer a partner-status that has no valid affiliation to God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَلَّا بَلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The rejection and replacement move from alleged plural associates to the singular divine identity. Unanswerable dominance and right judgment do not describe the strongest member of a coalition; together they remove any functional need or jurisdiction for a co-ruler.

activation_trace.role: The worshiped one supplies the singular identity installed after the rejection.
Overcoming power excludes a rival able to compel or counterbalance Him.
Knowledge that hits the right judgment excludes a co-adviser needed to correct divine rule.

changed_reading.before: God is asserted to be stronger and wiser than competing powers.
changed_reading.after: The alleged competition is categorically replaced by a singular locus of worship, unconquered power, and right governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah admits striking nondivine action while marking it as licensed, commanded, and cognitively limited. This revises a blanket denial of secondary agency: the focus rejects the promotion of dependent agents into holders of a shared divine stake.

activation_trace.role: Shared participation is the status whose legitimacy must be distinguished from mere action.
Purposeful work confirms that a secondary being can genuinely act.
Permission makes that genuine action dependent rather than co-sovereign.
The hidden domain from which the workers are excluded supplies a decisive cognitive limit.
An intercessor joins another's case, showing a real mediating relation that is still not independent partnership.
The repeated permission gate keeps mediation within divine authorization.

structural_cues: 34:12 places powerful labor before Solomon under the Lord's permission and command.
34:14 reveals the workers' ignorance only when Solomon falls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real work, licensing, ignorance of the hidden, and conditional intercession; I infer that dependence blocks elevation into shared rule. A live alternative is that these scenes illustrate separate miracles and need not define the category of partner.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies every meaningful action by any nondivine being.
changed_reading.after: The focus permits delegated action but demands proof for the illicit upgrade from dependent agent to independent partner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence operationalizes the focus challenge as a relational audit. The alleged powers must be summonable and must show some ownership, shared stake, supporting capacity, or authorized mediation; each route is denied or subordinated.

activation_trace.role: Attachment names the relation that the preceding audit decomposes into possible functions.
Calling by speech supplies a practical summons before the later demand to show.
A statement without certainty marks the partner-status as claimant-supplied rather than evidenced.
Ownership and disposal supply the first operative relation explicitly denied.
An actual shared stake supplies the second relation explicitly denied.
Back-strengthening and aid supply the third relation explicitly denied.
Joining another's case supplies the final mediating relation, effective only conditionally.
Permission places even valid mediation under the authority it cannot share.

structural_cues: 34:22 moves through atom-sized ownership, share, and backing under repeated comprehensive negation.
34:23 appends intercession but gates it with permission.
34:24-27 repeat قُلْ as a sequence of tests rather than a single isolated retort.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered series of denied relations; I read the series as an operational audit whose conclusion is the demand to show the attached partners. It may instead be cumulative emphasis without an intended taxonomy.

changed_reading.before: The command asks only for the names or visible bodies of idols.
changed_reading.after: The command asks claimants to exhibit any valid ownership, share, support, or authorized mediation by which their candidates function as partners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior promise to gather the parties and open between them by truth turns the focus imperative into an evidentiary moment within anticipated adjudication. Showing the alleged partners is not only observational; it is production of the claimed relation before the One who judges it.

activation_trace.role: Causative presentation supplies the evidentiary act demanded in the next speech.
Judgment seals the focus as an adjudication of the alleged relation.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the court-like assembly.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the decisive separation between claims.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the standard by which the displayed relation is judged.

structural_cues: 34:25 separates each side's responsibility before 34:26 gathers them.
The sequence in 34:26 is gathering, then judicial opening by truth, followed immediately by the focus command.
The focus ends with الْحَكِيمُ after its evidentiary demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, judicial opening, truth, and the next command to present; I connect them as assembly followed by production of evidence. A live alternative is that 34:27 begins a fresh polemical question rather than a courtroom phase.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a free-standing rhetorical taunt.
changed_reading.after: The ayah anticipates a hearing: produce the supposed co-parties and their title before truth separates the litigants.

context_deltas.mechanism: False affiliation is socially enacted. Following occurs without coercive authority, then the later weak/arrogant exchange exposes prestige, persistent command, and deliberate making as the machinery that installs rivals. The second-person plural in the focus assigns the community responsibility for the attachment even while influence is unequal.

activation_trace.role: Assigned affiliation supplies the status that social actors collectively manufacture.
Loyal following supplies the behavioral vehicle by which a claim acquires a community.
The denied power and jurisdiction show that the following was not produced by irresistible authority.
Lack of strength identifies the socially subordinate side of the partner-making exchange.
Self-magnification identifies the prestige-bearing side that directs the exchange.
Demand and obligation supply the repeated pressure exerted by the dominant group.
Making something assume a state supplies the explicit production of rival-status.
A contrary equal supplies the status into which the commanded objects are made.

structural_cues: 34:20 pairs following with the absence of coercive authority in 34:21.
34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between those made weak and those acting great.
34:33 locates the command to make rivals inside repeated night-and-day scheming, yet ends by requiting what all parties did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary following, unequal social position, command, and explicit making of rivals; I infer a collective production process behind أَلْحَقْتُم. The alternative is to treat each person's assent as the only causal level and the hierarchy as merely exculpatory argument.

changed_reading.before: Attaching partners is a private intellectual mistake by isolated worshipers.
changed_reading.after: Attaching partners is a socially administered status-production in which leaders command, followers ratify, and neither side can transfer responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later gathering supplies an enacted answer to 'show me.' The beings toward whom worship was directed are brought into a direct question, but their own speech purges the claimed affiliation and redirects allegiance to God; the next verse removes every capacity for mutual benefit or harm.

activation_trace.role: Showing anchors the later scene as a possible performed answer to the focus demand.
Attributed affiliation identifies what the questioned beings themselves repudiate.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination makes the alleged relation present for confrontation.
Submissive worship specifies the actual human conduct put to the questioned beings.
Purging and exoneration supply the beings' repudiation of the attached status.
Allegiance and protective loyalty are redirected exclusively to God rather than the worshipers.
The loss of disposal between parties removes any operative mutual control.
Benefit names one practical capacity that the alleged relation cannot deliver.
Harm completes the practical polarity that the alleged partners cannot control.

structural_cues: 34:40 asks the assembled beings أَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ, turning reference into direct confrontation.
34:41 repeats بَلْ while the questioned beings reject the worshipers' assigned relation.
34:42 follows the disavowal with no mutual ownership of benefit or harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, direct questioning, disavowal, and incapacity; I read this later scene as the dramatic fulfillment of the focus's ostensive test. It may instead be a thematic echo rather than a proleptic scene encoded in 34:27.

changed_reading.before: The challenge succeeds because no candidate can be physically produced.
changed_reading.after: Candidates may be brought and pointed to, but their own testimony dissolves the alleged affiliation; the missing object is a valid partnership relation, not a visible being.

context_deltas.mechanism: The epithet الْعَزِيزُ is sharpened by a surah-wide pursuit pattern. Opponents try to outstrip the signs, are made present, and finally encounter no escape before being seized from near; a supposed partner therefore cannot function as an exit, counterforce, or rescue capacity.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming and subduing power supplies the divine predicate tested by attempted evasion.
Attempted outstripping and escape introduce the contest that the epithet resolves.
Repetition of attempted escape shows a sustained strategy rather than an isolated boast.
Being brought into presence reverses the attempt to remain beyond reach.
Failure of reach or escape closes the possibility of outrunning judgment.
Capture and seizure give the no-escape pattern its concrete endpoint.

structural_cues: The same مُعَاجِزِينَ formulation occurs near the opening in 34:5 and after the focus in 34:38.
34:38 converts attempted outstripping into forced presence.
34:51 closes with فَلَا فَوْتَ and seizure from a near place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted evasion, forced presence, no escape, and capture; I infer that الْعَزِيزُ denies any partner capable of furnishing an exit. The alternative is that the pursuit sequence concerns rejection of signs generally, not the function assigned to partners.

changed_reading.before: الْعَزِيزُ is a general honorific for superior strength.
changed_reading.after: الْعَزِيزُ answers a concrete escape strategy: no attached power can outstrip, counterforce, or extract anyone from His reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the surah's metalworking and image-making vocabulary into a theological relation. It remains anchored in the causative attachment أَلْحَقْتُم and the shared structure of شُرَكَاءَ, while measured linking and manufactured forms provide a coherent material analogy. Downstream prose should present it only as a fabrication metaphor, not as the lexical meaning of the focus words.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing onto another anchors the material analogy in the focus construction.
Constructing a shared stake supplies the conceptual object produced by the joining.
Repeated purposeful making supplies the crafted-action side of the analogy.
Sizing a thing to its proper measure supplies deliberate construction rather than accidental contact.
Piercing and linking rings supplies the concrete image of assembled attachment.
A fashioned representation supplies the visible product onto which agency can be projected.

changed_reading.before: The claimants merely choose preexisting partners.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they fabricate a relational assembly, fastening represented powers onto God as deliberately as rings or forms are constructed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hunter's-snare branch of ش ر ك rather than the ordinary partner branch. It remains root-anchored and gains a visible follow-to-capture mechanism from the surah. Downstream prose must call it a snare-like echo of false partnership, never translate شُرَكَاءَ as snares.

activation_trace.role: The hunter's entangling device supplies the outlier image latent in the partnership root.
Following in another's track supplies voluntary movement into the entangling relation.
Failure to get beyond reach supplies the closed-trap condition.
Capture and seizure complete the snare-like sequence.

changed_reading.before: False partners are only ineffective allies outside the worshiper.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-image echo, the attachments become self-entered snares: following the claimed allies terminates in inescapable capture.

strongest_changes: The command to show becomes a functional audit of ownership, share, backing, and permission-gated mediation.
The surah distinguishes real delegated agency from the unsupported promotion of an agent into a partner.
The prior truth-judgment scene and later gathered disavowal turn the focus into an anticipated evidentiary confrontation.
The plural act of attachment becomes a social production involving prestige, command, following, and retained responsibility.
الْعَزِيزُ acquires a no-escape force from repeated attempted outstripping, forced presence, and capture.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed a short denial into a test of relation rather than mere visibility: candidates can exist, act, and even be presented, yet no valid shared title survives operational audit or their own testimony. Material crafting and snare branches remained live only as contained exploratory overlays.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 34:40-42 is intentionally a dramatic fulfillment of 34:27 or only a strong thematic echo.
Whether the forged-affiliation branch should enter ordinary prose or remain an exploratory juridical analogy.
Whether the four denied relations in 34:22-23 form an intended exhaustive taxonomy.
Whether the crafted-attachment and snare images add explanatory value beyond their diagnostic role as branch activations.
